register.notes: Two overloads (live inspect): client-visible with required wire { viewSchema, view }, or HOST-ONLY whose 'state is omitted from client snapshots and always checkpointed'. Registrants sharing a key share one unit and are refcounted; registration is an effect (disposer rides the fiber). ProjectionDefinition = { key, stateSchema, init(header, inheritedEventCount), apply(state, event), wire?, stateVersion }.

stateOf.notes: Returns undefined when the key is not registered; the returned value is live and must not be mutated.

snapshot.notes: Synchronous, one consistent cut; only client-visible units (wire defined) appear. Companion reads: cachedSnapshot, checkpoint, restoreFloor, viewCheckpoint, restore, hydrate, onChanged.
